anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch), in the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block, the 22 nF sampling capacitor C25 (to GND) and the 1 kΩ series resistor R13 (to the A1 'BTN' electrode) are tied to a single node that carries BOTH global labels NET0001 and NET0003. NET0001 is attached to U4 pin 27 (PB5) and NET0003 to U4 pin 59 (PB7). The two TSC group IOs are therefore shorted together at the cap/resistor junction (the overlap tile on the next page confirms R13's left terminal is on NET0003 while the same wire also bears NET0001).
anomalies.expected: The specification keeps these two nets separate: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)'. PB5 must drive the electrode through the series resistor, and PB7 must carry only the sampling capacitor; the two MCU pins must not be connected.

evidence.quote: Page 1 (PCB.kicad_sch), 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)': GND–C25 22n–(node labelled NET0003 over NET0001)–R13 1k–A1 BTN; SHLD–GND. MCU labels: PB5(27)=NET0001, PB7(59)=NET0003.
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN; TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)

anomalies.impact: PB5 and PB7 are shorted, so the STM32 Touch Sensing Controller cannot present a sampling capacitor on one IO and a driven electrode on the other; the touch button will not function (and the two push-pull GPIOs fight each other).

anomalies.observed: On the root sheet, the Tag-Connect programming header J2 (Conn_ARM_SWD_TagConnect_TC2030) has pin 6 (SWO) wired straight to a GND symbol; no wire runs from SWO to the MCU's SWO pin (PC3).
anomalies.expected: Per the spec the header's six pins form 'a standard ARM debug/programming interface' including SWO, i.e. SWO should be routed to the MCU trace output, not tied to ground.

evidence.quote: Page 1, 'Programming (SWD)': J2 pin 6 'SWO' wire terminates on a GND symbol.
Its pins are VCC, GND, ~RESET, SWCLK, SWDIO, SWO — a standard ARM debug/programming interface

anomalies.impact: SWD programming still works, but the SWO trace output is dead (shorted to ground at the header), removing the ITM/trace capability the interface is meant to provide.

parsed.summary: The reference-designator renumbering throughout the drawing (MCU=U4, NFC=U1, OLED=U3, etc.) is only a labelling convention and is not an anomaly; however the capacitive-touch block merges the two TSC IOs (PB5/NET0001 and PB7/NET0003) onto one node so the sampling capacitor and series resistor are no longer on separate pins, breaking the touch sensing, and the header SWO pin is tied to ground instead of the MCU trace line.
